ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture（中世日本 - 文化）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development prototype. Adds a candidate traditional floor seat (enza), with source-only eating-Job integration under development, and makes the AteWithoutTable mood effect neutral. Includes the compiled RimWorld 1.6 AMJ.Culture meal-seat adapter. Actual meal, Comfort and Vanilla table precedence still require in-game acceptance; not approved for release.
開発用試作。円座による床座の食事機能を開発中。RimWorld 1.6用の食事処理DLLを同梱。円座での食事・快適性獲得は実ゲーム未検証。テーブルなし食事の心情補正は0。実機検証・公開は未実施。
